title: Verify with targeted checks after fixing failures
summary: After resolving a build, lint, or test failure, run the smallest targeted verification command before concluding and solidify the verified fix as a Fix experience.
strategy: Run the narrowest failing test or build command first to reproduce.
Apply a minimal, surgical fix without unrelated changes.
Re-run the verification command to confirm green output before finishing.
Call evo_solidify if the root cause is non-obvious and reusable across projects.

title: Handle Windows paths and PowerShell syntax safely
summary: On Windows, use backslash paths, avoid bash heredocs, and wrap cmd.exe .bat scripts in a single subshell.
strategy: Prefer Windows backslash separators and native PowerShell commands over bash syntax.
Avoid heredoc syntax (<<EOF); pass inline scripts via here-strings (@' ... '@).
For .cmd/.bat toolchains, run setup and target command in the same shell invocation.

guardrail.reason: Heredoc syntax fails in PowerShell on Windows; use a single-quoted here-string instead.

title: Sanitize secrets and local paths before sharing experiences
summary: Never persist tokens, private keys, internal IPs, or personal filesystem paths in shared Rules or Fixes.
strategy: Replace literal credentials with environment variable names such as process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN.
Replace user-specific paths (/Users/<name>, C:\Users\<name>) with placeholders or relative paths.
Run evo_sync_repo only after leak checks pass.
